summary: Work across platform decoder/encoder backends improves codec correctness, hardware acceleration stability, and color/HDR handling. AV1 SVC temporal IDs are preserved end-to-end, FFmpeg and hardware decoders now preserve color metadata (important for accurate colors), Vulkan video and NVIDIA/Wayland paths receive robustness fixes and device caching, and HDR formats like BT.2100 PQ with NV12 layouts are handled more correctly so luminance and wide-gamut colors are presented properly. There are also hardenings to VideoToolbox/WMF/AppleVT encoder state machines and rules to keep platform encoding out of the content process to avoid crashes and leaks; overall this means more reliable hardware-accelerated playback and encoding.
